title: Faculty Info Lecturer on Education Director of Learning and Outreach Project Zero Degrees Ed.M., Harvard University, (2002)
bio: Tina Blythe has been a researcher with Project Zero since 1988. She has focused on professional development, teacher inquiry, and collaborative assessment of student work, as well as curriculum and instruction that emphasizes learning for understanding in both classrooms and afterschool programs.
research_interests: With deep expertise that connects research
